title: Fighting Spiritual Wickedness with the Victory of Jesus
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he explores the biblical truth about the last days and the growing deception in the world. With Pastor Chris's straight-talking and Bible-teaching approach, you'll discover how to stand firm in your faith and resist the pressures of a world that's rapidly falling apart. From the book of Matthew to the spiritual battles we face today, this powerful sermon will leave you encouraged, equipped, and eager to share the hope of Christ with others.
